title: Pumping Ancient Water from beneath the Sahara Desert
description:
Discover the vast underground aquifers hidden deep beneath the Sahara Desert, holding fresh water that fell as rain over ten thousand years ago. Learn how modern agriculture is utilizing this hidden resource to grow crops in the arid sand.

Understand the high stakes of depleting a non-renewable water supply that takes millennia to naturally replenish, threatening the future of desert farming and local ecosystems.

#SaharaDesert #Groundwater #WaterScarcity #Documentary
